notes.title: Game Update 1.1.0b
notes.notes:
Here's what's new in this patch:

🖥️ Interface & Visual Improvements

 Revamped interface for a sleeker and more intuitive experience.
 Enhanced visuals to make every moment more immersive.
 Upgraded audio effects for heightened suspense and atmosphere.

🎴 New Gameplay Additions

 Trump Cards: A new strategic twist to keep the gameplay fresh and exciting.

🕹️ New Game Modes
[olist]
 Standard Mode: Classic gameplay with all the original rules.
 Quickmatch Mode: High-paced action where players start with 3 points and have only 3 seconds per hand!
 Training Mode: Practice without fear—this mode removes all danger, perfect for honing your skills.
[/olist]
📋 Improved Menus

 Added a Settings Menu, now featuring:
 Video Settings: Customize your visuals.
 Audio Settings: Adjust sound levels for your preferred experience.
 How to Play Menu: Learn or revisit the rules of the game.

This update is just the beginning—thank you for your support and feedback! We can’t wait to hear what you think.
See you at the table! 🃏
